_comment: Documentation of what the cited shared-responsibility matrix (the MAP oracle) assigns at each slider position. No spec check uses from:generated — mapping_correct reads ctx.map directly against the cited keyByModel/keyZone — so these underscore-prefixed keys are documentation the replay test asserts against the matrix, never injected expectations. The cited matrix (AWS SRM + CSA CAIQ + NIST 800-53) is the oracle; there is no authored per-render answer key.
